lines.note: Big and happy. These get heard a LOT.
Just the name of each letter: "A" (ay), "B" (bee)…
The SOUND each letter makes, short and clipped. Try not to add much "uh" after b, d, g, p, t. Hold s, m, n, f, l, v, z, r for about a second.
lines.hint: the sound A makes (short a, as in apple)
the sound C makes (hard c, as in cat)
the sound E makes (short e, as in egg)
the sound G makes (hard g, as in goat)
the sound I makes (short i, as in itch)
the sound O makes (short o, as in octopus)
the sound Q makes (as in queen)
the sound U makes (short u, as in up)
the sound X makes (as at the end of box)

lines.note: Say each word clearly, like you are reading it to him.
Clear and simple. ("a" and "I" are already covered by the letter names.)
The whole word, then (next section) each part on its own.
Each part on its own, like clapping it out: "dye"… "no"… "sore". The hint shows which word it comes from.

lines.note: One short reason for each thing.
lines.text: Cans get made into new cans!
Paper can be made into new paper!
Glass can be melted and used again!
It's food, so it goes in compost!
Food scraps turn into dirt for plants!
Old sponges go in the trash.
Popped balloons go in the trash.
A ball is round, like a circle!
A full moon is a circle!
A slice of pizza is a triangle!
This rice ball is a triangle!
Sully wants the ball! Throw it!
First, the excavator digs the hole.
Tap the scissors to cut the ribbon!
The hole is dug! Now the dump truck!
Tap the digger to load it up!
Back it up to the hole!
The hole is full of gravel! Now the cement mixer!
Drive the truck to the digger first!
to put it in the mixer!
Tap the drum to spin it! Spin it ten times!
Rub the cement to make it smooth!
Now write your letter in the wet cement!
What comes next in the pattern?
Tap to drop it on the building!
Now the roof! Tap to drop it!
A circle is round, with no corners.
A square has four sides, all the same.
Knock knock, here comes the door!
Put the flag on top of the building!
Put the cat next to the door!
Put the flowers under the window!
Pick a color, then tap the building.
Back to the job site to cut the ribbon!
Tap the building to paint it!
